title: Callvale after: a rotated secret
claim: After: the application's IAM role reads a rotated secret, and ACM certificates sit on the load balancer and CloudFront.
alt: After: the instances read the database password from Secrets Manager with their IAM role, Secrets Manager rotates the password in the secret and in the database, plain configuration sits in Parameter Store, and ACM certificates sit on the load balancer and on CloudFront.
notes: Brief 07 story pair, after; 2-deep.md#secrets-manager-replaces-a-stored-password-with-a-call-at-run-time (after the trace). Title, claim, alt from brief.json; no steps. Same cells as secrets-certificates-before: CloudFront A1, ACM B1, load balancer A2, web A3, workers B3, database A5:B5; Secrets Manager takes the cells of the two files (A4:B4), Parameter Store the empty B2. A role sends nothing: the read runs from the instances to Secrets Manager. No AWS number or rule in the drawing.
